name: Outlet Premium
summary: Las Vegas Premium Outlets North is a premier outlet shopping destination featuring designer and brand-name stores at discounted prices. With over 3,100 positive reviews and a 4.5-star rating, this popular center serves both tourists and locals seeking quality merchandise at exceptional values.
demographics: Las Vegas Premium Outlets North attracts a diverse mix of tourists and locals seeking value shopping, with visitors typically ranging from middle to upper-middle income households. The center draws heavily from the Las Vegas tourist population, including domestic and international travelers aged 25-55 who are bargain-conscious yet brand-aware shoppers. The trade area encompasses both the North Las Vegas residential communities and the broader Las Vegas metropolitan area, with shopping patterns showing peak traffic during tourist seasons and weekends when families and groups seek designer brands at discounted prices.
description: Las Vegas Premium Outlets North stands as one of Nevada's premier outlet shopping destinations, offering an exceptional collection of designer and brand-name stores at compelling discount prices. Located at 725-929 South Grand Central Parkway in Las Vegas, this expansive outlet center has established itself as a must-visit destination for both tourists and locals seeking high-quality merchandise at reduced prices. The center features a carefully curated mix of premium outlet retailers, providing shoppers with access to top fashion brands, accessories, home goods, and more, all within a convenient open-air shopping environment. Operating daily from 10:00 AM to 8:00 PM, the outlet center maintains a strong reputation with an impressive 4.5-star rating from over 3,100 reviews, reflecting its commitment to customer satisfaction and quality shopping experiences. With its strategic location in Las Vegas and comprehensive selection of outlet stores, Las Vegas Premium Outlets North has become an integral part of the city's retail landscape, offering visitors an attractive alternative to traditional mall shopping while delivering significant savings on premium brands.
